predictions.articleTitle: OCPAM vs Olympique Marcquois Prediction: Tier Gap vs Unbeaten Cup Form — Model Analysis
predictions.coreRecommendation: OCPAM are marginally favored to avoid defeat in 90 minutes via a tight 1:0 win or 1:1 stalemate under 2.5 goals, though unverified starting XIs keep confidence low.
possibilityAssessment: Home Win / Draw behind fifth-tier quality, home venue, and a 68.0% combined Poisson win-or-draw share (Confidence: Low, Value: Moderate)
Under 2.5 Goals driven by a 2.25 combined lambda and 60.9% Poisson probability in a cagey cup tie (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)
1:1 regulation draw if Marcquois's transition threat punishes OCPAM's recent home defensive lapses (Confidence: Low, Value: Moderate)

bet_recommendations.match_highlight: Can unbeaten Régional 1 leaders Marcquois exploit OCPAM's recent defensive leaks?

spf.comment: Covers a narrow 1:0 home win backed by OCPAM's higher-tier status alongside a 1:1 stalemate, as recent home defensive fragility makes a single win call too exposed.

over_under.comment: Supported by a 2.25 combined lambda (60.9% Under 2.5 Poisson share) and Marcquois's tight defensive record of four goals conceded in seven league matches.

score.comment: 1:0 reflects OCPAM edging 90 minutes on home soil, while 1:1 (top Poisson cell at 13.3%) covers a resilient counter-attacking response from Marcquois.

goals.comment: Matches the top two Poisson goal-count probabilities (26.7% for 2 goals and 23.7% for 1 goal) in a tight knockout matchup.

bqc.comment: Projects a cautious level first half before OCPAM's higher-tier fitness forces a second-half winner or Marcquois hold on for a regulation stalemate.
